<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class { public function value(): int { return 7; } }; }
};
$after = new class {};
$a = $owner->make(); $b = $owner->make();
echo $owner::class, ';', $a::class, ';', $b::class, ';', $after::class, ';', $a->value(), ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function first() { return new class {}; }
    public function second() { return new class {}; }
};
$after = new class {};
$second = $owner->second(); $first = $owner->first();
echo $owner::class, ';', $first::class, ';', $second::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() { return new class {
        public function inner() { return new class {}; }
    }; }
};
$after = new class {};
$child = $owner->make(); $grand = $child->inner();
echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $grand::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public object $child;
    public function __construct() { $this->child = new class {}; echo 'CTOR;'; }
};
$after = new class {};
echo $owner::class, ';', get_class($owner->child), ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
try {
    $owner = new class {
        public object $child;
        public function __construct() {
            $this->child = new class { public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD-DTOR;'; } };
            echo 'MADE;';
            throw new Exception('stop');
        }
        public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER-DTOR;'; }
    };
} catch (Exception $error) { echo 'CAUGHT;'; }
echo 'END;';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public static function make() { return new class {}; }
};
$child = $owner::make();
echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function make() {
        return new class(self::class, static::class) {
            public function __construct(public string $self, public string $late) {}
            public function own(): string { return self::class; }
        };
    }
};
$child = $owner->make();
echo $owner::class, ';', $child->self, ';', $child->late, ';', $child->own(), ';';

<?php
class R180Base { protected function __construct(int $value) { echo 'BASE;', $value, ';'; } }
$owner = new class extends R180Base {
    public function __construct() {}
    public function make() { return new class(5) extends R180Base {}; }
};
$child = $owner->make();
echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
class R180LexBase {}
$owner = new class extends R180LexBase {
    public function make() {
        return new class(self::class, parent::class, static::class) {
            public function __construct(public string $self, public string $parent, public string $static) {}
            public function own(): string { return self::class; }
        };
    }
};
$child = $owner->make();
echo $child->self, ';', $child->parent, ';', $child->static, ';', $child->own(), ';';

<?php
class R180FinalBase { final public function value(): int { return 1; } }
$owner = new class {
    public function make() {
        echo 'ENTER;';
        return new class((print 'ARG;')) extends R180FinalBase {
            public function __construct(int $value) {}
            public function value(): int { return 2; }
        };
    }
};
echo 'BEFORE;';
$owner->make();
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public function uncalled() { $child = new class {
        public function bad(int $value = 'bad') {}
    }; }
};
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
$owner = new class {
    public static function __construct() {
        $child = new class { public function bad(int $value = 'bad') {} };
    }
};
echo 'BAD;';

<?php

    public function bad(int $value = 'bad') {}
    public function make() { return new class {}; }

    public int $bad = 'bad';

<?php

    public static function __construct() {}

<?php
class R180ParentedCompleteBase {}
$owner = new class extends R180ParentedCompleteBase {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
};
class R180LaterBad {
    public static function __construct() {}
}
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class R180FinalPriority { final public function value(): int { return 1; } }
$owner = new class extends R180FinalPriority {
    public function make() { return new class { public function bad(int $value = 'bad') {} }; }
    public function value(): int { return 2; }
};
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class R180OwnerBase { final public function value(): int { return 1; } }
echo 'BEFORE;';
$owner = new class extends R180OwnerBase {
    public function make() { return new class {}; }
    public function value(): int { return 2; }
};
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class R180NamedOuterForward extends R180NamedBaseForward {
    public function make() {
        return new class {
            public function inner() { return new class {}; }
        };
    }
}
class R180NamedBaseForward {}
$owner = (new R180NamedOuterForward)->make();
$child = $owner->inner();
$after = new class {};
echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';
